description: Terry Waters is a lifelong South Alabama resident, farmer, veteran, and small business owner who believes in hard work, faith, and common sense. He was raised on a family farm in Robertsdale by his parents, Donnie and Norma Waters, alongside his brothers. Growing up, Terry learned early that no one is entitled to anything and that success comes from working hard and doing what’s right.
